preconditions.description: Number of towns, roads, types of goods, and required types are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= k for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each town produces a type of good within the range [1, k].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct towns within the range [1, n].
All types of goods from 1 to k are produced in at least one town.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers, one for each town.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum travel expenses.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(d[u][v] for v in range(n) if a[v] != a[u]) <= output[u] for u in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each town u, the sum of travel expenses to bring goods from all other towns producing different types is less than or equal to the output value for town u.
